title: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association advances ASEAN decarbonisation
summary: Thailand: The Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has helped reduce the ASEAN cement indus

sources.title: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association advances ASEAN decarbonisation
sources.excerpt: Thailand: The Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has helped reduce the ASEAN cement industry’s CO₂ emissions by 14.4Mt in 2025, down by 6% year-on-year against 2020 levels, under the 2035 ASEAN Federation of Cement Manufacturers (AFCM) Decarbonisation Roadmap. The reductions were attributed to increased adoption of reduced-CO₂ cement, alternative fuels and renewable electricity.
